questions: Is the ONNX path tokenizing with a real tokenizer or a stub?
Can the tokenizers crate load a tokenizer offline (no Hub fetch)?
Where does the tokenizer.json path come from, and what if it's absent?

findings.claim: simple_tokenize hashes words into arbitrary ids [1000,30000); ONNX gets meaningless input_ids
tokenizers http feature disabled by default; Tokenizer::from_file is offline; use default-features=false for pure-Rust
onnx loaders carry unused OnnxConfig - natural seam for tokenizer path
B-32 flaky cli env-var test folds into this cycle

decision: offline tokenizers config adopted; sub-decisions (vocab path, fallback policy) to operator
